rows.grounds: compound: sādhya (target) + nāma (name) + anvitā (endowed-with), accusative singular feminine qualifying māyāṃ
compound: madhya (middle) + koṣṭha (cell), locative of place
injunctive instruction continuing the writing procedure

items.question: In which cell must the māyā marked with the target's name be inscribed?
premises: The preceding instruction directs writing to proceed clockwise from the upper cell.
The object to be written is the māyā endowed with the target's name.
The middle cell is specified as the location for this inscription.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner should inscribe the māyā marked with the target's name in the middle cell.
uncertainties: The precise referent of the previously stated result in the immediate context is not fully explicit within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: One should write the māyā, marked with the name of the target, in the middle cell.
